Poor food quality
Jun 2024 • Friends
I saw great reviews for this restaurant, particularly noting that one of its locations is Michelin-selected, so I decided to make a reservation. Unfortunately, they were fully booked and suggested I visit their second location, which they claimed was more comfortable with the same quality.

I visited the second location with high expectations, but I was disappointed. The Canh Chua had a lovely soup, but the fish, a key ingredient, was super dry and tasted like it had been pre-cooked and reheated, resulting in overcooking. The beef skewers were tough, extremely dry, and served lukewarm. The Nem Nuong was pasty and off-tasting. Finally, I ordered the sugarcane and lemongrass chicken, which was recommended on their menu. It sounded appealing but came out bland, with the chicken drowned in a gravy that had an unpleasant taste.

Overall, the experience was disappointing. If the first location is indeed Michelin-selected, I question the consistency of their food quality. It might be that the second location had a chef in training who wasn't up to the task.
